subject: Northbridge — post-demo bench plan & cost matrix
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Northbridge — post-demo bench plan & cost matrix

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid rundown of your inference pain points (spiky inference volume, strict P95 latency targets for interactive features, and the cost surprises coming from the hyperscaler). Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get a controlled comparison that matters to your stack.

What we heard from you:
- Typical request mix: 70% chat-style (avg 600 tokens output), 30% short completion (~80 tokens)
- Current hyperscaler unit pricing you see in billing: ~ $35 / 1M tokens (including transform and networking margins)
- Target latency: P95 < 350ms for the desktop app, < 150ms for internal tooling (preferred)
- Success criteria for evaluation: 1) unit cost delta vs hyperscaler, 2) ability to hit P95 targets at production QPS, 3) predictable fallbacks and SLOs

Proposed next tests (short):
1) Controlled per-1M token runs: we’ll run both CloudX/hyperscaler baseline (your representative API calls) and Redwood on identical prompt/sequence distributions to report token counts, latencies, and cost per 1M tokens.
2) Batching matrix: batch sizes [1, 4, 8, 16] at target concurrency to show throughput vs latency tradeoffs.
3) Cache profiling: run with no cache, 50% simulated prefix reuse, and your historical prefix distribution (you can share sample sessions) to quantify effective token reduction.
4) Cost model: we’ll produce an apples-to-apples cost_model_v1.csv that includes GPU-cost amortization, networking, and effective per-1M token after batching/cache.

What we need from you to run this next week:
- Representative prompt set (a small sample is fine) — you can drop in the Drive link or attach.
- A target QPS to model (p95/avg) and any hard latency constraints.
- Permission to call the hyperscaler endpoint for a small set of test runs (we won’t exceed 10k requests).

I’ve attached a draft bench matrix and cost model template. Marcus will scope the exact runbook. If OK, can we lock a 60-minute bench session on Wednesday? I’ll invite Marcus + Laura.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: redwood_vs_hyperx_bench_matrix.xlsx, cost_model_v1.csv

Soojin,

Thanks — that matches our internal notes. A few clarifications before we run:
- The $35 / 1M tokens is what we see on our monthly bill for the managed endpoint we're using (includes transformation + endpoint fees). Some of that is variable depending on sequence length.
- Our production average QPS is low (~2-3 QPS) but with bursts up to 120 QPS during business hours. Latency spikes are what kill adoption with our product team.
- We can provide a 2000-line dump of anonymized prompt+response pairs (strip PII) — will share via the Drive link you provided.

Wednesday works for a bench session — prefer 11am PT. Marcus should have access to our cloud test account, but if not I’ll get IT to open a temporary key.

Sara
Head of ML Infrastructure | Northbridge Analytics
sara@northbridge.ai
